title: Variadic sum and mean
hints: Inside the function `nums` is a slice (`[]int`). `len(nums)` is how many arguments were passed, and `for _, n := range nums` visits each one.
`Sum`: start with `total := 0`, add each `n`, return `total`. `Mean`: first check `len(nums) == 0` and return `0, errors.New(...)`.
`return float64(Sum(nums...)) / float64(len(nums)), nil`. The `...` passes the slice on as the variadic arguments.
